meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in Hackney, Mare Street
meta.description: Bike servicing, same-day repairs, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney. Book a service or just turn up.

rationale: A railway-arch workshop for couriers and commuters wants to feel like it works late: near-black ground, one acid lime accent, tall condensed headlines and hard square edges. The price ledger answers the main question (what does it cost) in the honest format of a workshop board, the marquee carries the same-day promise, and big contact type suits customers who call or walk in. Steel frame restoration, the owner's passion, gets its own feature with a photo brief rather than a line in a list.

props.label: Steel frames
props.title: The part Dami loves most
props.intro: Everything else keeps London moving. This is why the arch exists.

featured.name: Old steel frame restoration
featured.description: Bring us the frame from the shed, the skip or your dad's garage. We strip it back, check every tube and join, repair what needs repairing, and build it up again so it rides the way it was meant to. Slow work, done properly, and no two jobs are the same.

photo.subject: A bare steel road frame in the workshop stand under a work lamp, close enough to see the lugs and brazing, with a finished restored bike leaning in the background

steps.detail: Walk in off Mare Street, or book a slot so the stand is ready for you.

steps.name: We look
steps.detail: Dami or Rosa checks the bike with you and tells you what it needs and what it costs.

steps.name: We fix
steps.detail: Small jobs while you wait. Services usually the same day, for couriers and commuters who can't be without a bike.

steps.name: Ride off
steps.detail: You get the old parts back if you want them, and a straight word on what to watch next.

props.label: The workshop
props.title: Two people, one arch
props.text: It's me, Dami, and Rosa. That's the whole team, so whoever takes your bike is the person who fixes it. Most of our regulars are couriers and commuters, so we work fast on the everyday jobs and save the long, patient hours for the steel frames.

photo.subject: Dami and Rosa in work aprons standing side by side in the railway arch workshop, tools on the wall behind them, natural and unposed

items.a: No. Turn up and we'll fit you in where we can. Booking a service just guarantees the stand is free when you arrive.

items.q: Can I wait while you fix it?
items.a: For punctures and brake fixes, yes. Services are usually done the same day.

items.q: Will you work on any bike?
items.a: Road, hybrid, commuter and courier bikes are our everyday work. If you're unsure about something unusual, call or message us first.

items.q: How do I know what a steel frame restoration will cost?
items.a: Bring the frame in. We'll look it over and quote you before we start.
